constraints.desc: The actions always take place. FW_Optional on the sequence only keeps its 24 orders apart from the covering selection, so every order runs with every kept combination of the static parameters.
A payment method riskier than the customer's trust is not offered: members cannot pay by invoice.
The shop's own terminal has no wallet reader.
The terminal is wired: its order request is never delivered twice (a late rule: it reads a sudden event).
Two sudden events never strike at the very same moment: when both happen, they happen after different actions.
